# GF-FINANCIAL-001

Independent exact-money oracle for ERP-630 P&L, Balance Sheet and direct Cash Flow.

The fixture proves layered accrual profit, unclosed earnings, the Balance Sheet equation, direct cash-flow classification, zero-impact own-account transfers and the separation of financing from revenue/expense.

`verify.mjs` uses only Node standard-library code and fixture files. It never imports production modules.
